notes: Real Grok Build 1.0.46 on the user's own subscription, in a trusted sandbox directory, in a tmux window (120x40; frame-* at 98x24, the size of the other fixtures' frame-* states; tmux answers no OSC 11), `tmux capture-pane -e -p` fed through Gluon's screen model. No prompt reached a model: text typed into the composer was never sent, except `/plan` ALONE + Enter (it only switches the mode: nothing runs, no turn). The path is scrubbed to ~/proj (column-preserving padding). Composer: a rounded box, `│ ❯ <input> │` (continuation rows `│   <input> │`), its bottom border carries the label `Grok 4.7 (low)` and, in a non-normal mode, ` · plan` / ` · auto-review` / ` · always-approve` (the word in its own colour); a hint row below (`Shift+Tab:mode │ Ctrl+x:shortcuts`, with text typed `Enter:send │ Alt+Enter:newline │ …`). Input wraps by words onto continuation rows (a long word by characters); the empty composer has no placeholder. A completion ghost (`/c` typed shows `/clear`) is the rest in grey 108,108,108 after the typed part (blue 122,162,247 for a command; typed text is 225,225,225); Tab accepts it. The slash menu is a panel above the composer: item rows `    ❯ /name  description` (the highlighted one: `❯`, bold, a lighter background) or six spaces for the others, sorted by fuzzy match (`/` alone: /quit first), a match count at the right of its top rule; Tab with one match shows a one-item panel. Cursor: the terminal cursor is VISIBLE after the first frames and is where the input ends (also on a wrapped row); it is hidden (`?25l`) only while the startup screen draws, and moves around while it animates: the recorded cursor is tmux's own (#{cursor_x},#{cursor_y}). A first screen with no key typed yet (idle, explore-idle, frame-idle) is a splash with the logo (it animates: colours differ per frame) and no header status; after the first key the session layout shows the header `main <path> … 1.8K / 256K │ [Dashboard]` (with `sandbox:read-only` after `main` when launched with --sandbox read-only: explore-*) and the hint row. Plan mode (`/plan` alone, Enter): the toast `✓ Plan mode: on` (a few seconds) and, for good, the border label `Grok 4.7 (low) · plan` with the border in amber (114,100,68) and `plan` in 196,169,111; `--permission-mode plan` does nothing in the TUI. Shift+Tab cycles normal → plan → auto-review → always-approve (a one-line `Switched to mode: Auto-review` notice). Keys are those typed since the composer was empty (the capture's driver typed them one at a time, 0.25 s apart). Never Enter on /clear or /compact. The slash menu lists the user's own skills too.
